issue.title: bob ref create -f|--force[=reread|overwrite]: recapture a source you already have
issue.description: A source that is already a reference can be captured again on purpose. Bare -f adds a new <root>__vN reading linked to the earlier ones. -f overwrite recaptures a reference in place and keeps its path, id, and reading task. Before that, anything you made in the old note is frozen into ref_history/. Without -f, a duplicate is refused before any fetch, with one clear message that names the existing copies and the exact fix.
